title: Settle amount fragility in BalancerPooler
description: unlockCallback ignores the amountsIn return from addLiquidity() and settles with the pre-transfer measured amount. For the hardcoded UNBALANCED kind, amountsIn == maxAmountsIn, so the settle IS correct. However, if the addLiquidity kind were ever changed, the settle would be incorrect. Defensive programming recommendation.
recommendation: Capture and use amountsIn return value for settle.
